definition_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, compact separators comma/colon; exclude definition_sha256 from the task being hashed; preserve array order

global_requirements: Use only features actually executable by frozen 0.4; no let/fn declarations, source input i32, signed input defaults, helper named args, named seed/v/a part args, mixed numeric palettes or geometry constructors.
Return a JSON object {"files":{"entry.ips":"exact source",...}} with UTF-8 source strings; no Markdown fence, explanation, binary files or absolute/traversal paths.
Use only direct bundled imports relative to entry.ips; no filesystem/network/environment access or nested imports.
All accepted programs must compile and execute with unmodified budgets and deterministic repeated outputs.
Image rules describing a base fill and overlay compose sequentially; base fill is not also asserted under later overlays.
For every task retain source-level required features; satisfying only sample pixels by hard-coded unrelated code is not success.

tasks.title: Centered panel and attachment
requirements: Create a standalone 32x32 asset with opaque background #101820 and an axis-aligned opaque #55bbff panel covering x=8..23, y=6..25.
Declare and write the singular point center={16,16}; use rect for both fills; do not draw anything else.

tasks.title: Four-by-four checkerboard
requirements: Fill the whole canvas with a 4x4 checkerboard of 8x8 opaque cells. Even (column+row) uses #55bbff; odd uses #ffdd88.
Use two nested integer for loops and an integer parity condition. Write point center={16,16}; no RNG.

tasks.title: Indexed palette bands
requirements: Declare color palette bands=[#112233,#445566,#778899,#aabbcc]. Fill four full-width eight-pixel-high bands in palette order from top to bottom.
Use palette indexing inside an integer loop. Write point center={16,16}; no extra drawing or RNG.

tasks.title: Variant and archetype badge
requirements: Declare variants=3 and archetypes=2. Use implicit v and a in draw. Fill background #101820.
Paint the rectangle at (8,8), width=8+4*v, height=8+4*a, using color palette [#ff4444,#44ff44,#4444ff] indexed by v.
Write point selected={v,a}; write rect bounds={8,8,8+4*v,8+4*a}. All variant/archetype cases must be valid.

tasks.title: Host uniforms control a panel
requirements: Declare input color tint=#55bbff, input f32 offset=0.0, input u32 count=4. Fill background #101820.
Draw opaque panel (8+offset,8,count,8,tint). Write point anchor={8+offset,8} and rect bounds={8+offset,8,count,8}.
Keep the declared input names/types/defaults and support every supplied override; no RNG or source-level i32 input.

tasks.title: Seeded dot placement and list outputs
requirements: Fill background #101820. Consume the current stream to place exactly 12 opaque #ffdd88 pixels at integer coordinates x,y in [4,27]. Use index(24)+4 separately for x and y.
Append each coordinate to output list point dots in draw order. Duplicate coordinates are allowed; no extra stream draws, no direct-seed calls, and no other drawing.

tasks.title: Probability-gated row
requirements: Declare input f32 probability=0.5. Fill background #101820. For i=0..15, call chance(probability) exactly once; if true, paint #55bbff at (2+i,16) and append that point to list stars.
Override probability=0 yields no stars; probability=1 yields all 16 stars in increasing x order. Preserve the default and do not add other random operations.

output_criteria.name: stars
output_criteria.point_rule: x in [2,17], y=16, unique increasing x

tasks.title: Direct-seed values preserve parent state
requirements: Save the initial seed in a local before any RNG operation; fill background #101820. Compute x=int(roll(hash(saved),4.0,28.0)) and paint one #ffdd88 pixel at (x,16).
Write point dot={x,16} and point states={float(saved),float(seed)} after the isolated roll. states.x and states.y must be bit-identical; no other RNG operation.

tasks.title: Typed drawing helper with four attachments
requirements: Fill background #101820. Declare helper leaf(center:vec2,tint:color) using existing helper syntax, with positional calls from draw.
Each call paints rect(center.x-2,center.y-3,4,6,tint) and appends center to output list point sockets.
Call the helper at {8,8}, {24,8}, {8,24}, {24,24}, in that order, all with #55bbff. No inputs, RNG, or direct drawing of the four panels outside the helper.

tasks.title: Translucent glaze on an opaque background
requirements: Fill the entire canvas with opaque #204060, then paint rectangle (8,8,16,16) using rgba(255,0,0,128). Do not clear the background or use translucent background.
Write rect glaze={8,8,16,16}. Inside and outside alpha stays 255; RGB inside follows the frozen source-over compositor.

tasks.title: One imported part and translated anchor
requirements: Return entry.ips and part.ips. part.ips must define an 8x8 asset with origin 0,0, color input tint=#55bbff, point output anchor={2,3}, and rect(1,2,3,2,tint). It has no imports.
Entry is 32x32, fills #101820, imports tile from "part.ips", and calls tile.draw(7,0,0,at={10,12},tint=#ffdd88).

After the call, write root point anchor=tile.outputs.anchor+{10,12}. Root anchor is {12,15}; part-owned anchor stays local {2,3}. Part outputs do not automatically include at/origin. Preserve geometry and paint order.

tasks.title: D4 rotation preserves geometry
requirements: Return entry.ips and part.ips. Part is 8x8 with origin 0,0, point anchor={2,3}, and an opaque #55bbff rect(1,2,3,2). It has no imports.
Root fills #101820 then calls tile.draw(7,0,0,at={16,16},rot=90). Write root point anchor=tile.outputs.anchor+{16,16}.

Use the exact positive 90-degree D4 transform from the reference, not vec2.rot or image filtering. The local continuous anchor maps to {3,6}; part-owned anchor remains local, and root explicitly adds placement to obtain {19,22}. Discrete pixels follow the frozen pixel-center mapping; at/origin is not transformed.

tasks.title: Singular geometry and an unset slot
requirements: Fill background #101820 and opaque rectangle (6,8,20,16,#55bbff).
Declare point center, rect bounds, circle hit, and point spare. Write center={16,16}, bounds={6,8,20,16}, hit={16,16,8}; leave spare unwritten.
Use the existing brace output syntax. spare must remain declared but unset; do not write dummy zero coordinates.

tasks.title: Dynamic color palette ramp
requirements: Declare color palette gradient=[#ff0000,#0000ff]. For every x=0..31, compute t=float(x)/31.0 and use ramp(gradient,t) to fill the full-height column x.
Write point ends={0,31}; no RNG, no extra colors, and do not replace ramp with hand-written color interpolation.

tasks.title: While loop with continue and break
requirements: Fill #101820. Use a while loop over increasing integer i starting at 0; skip i=3 with continue and stop at i=6 with break.
For each retained i paint rect(4,2+4*i,24,2,#ffdd88) and append point {4,2+4*i} to list rungs. Exactly indices 0,1,2,4,5 are emitted, in this order.
The loop must terminate in every render case without a fuel trap; do not replace the required while/continue/break with five literal calls.

tasks.title: Bounded seeded marble
requirements: Produce a full opaque 32x32 blue marble tile with a coherent noise.fbm domain, using a saved explicit seed and the reference noise signature.
Use a color ramp between #102840 and #75c9ef; sample only a small finite coordinate domain and keep octaves/loop bounds small enough for the unmodified 1,000,000 fuel budget.
Write point center={16,16}. The image must have at least eight distinct opaque RGB colors, be bit-identical for repeated identical inputs, and vary across supplied seeds.
human_visual_criteria: Blue marble appearance with coherent veins or bands, not unrelated pixel noise.
Record a human review as pass/fail/pending with reviewer and artifact hashes. Automated opacity/color-count checks do not prove this visual requirement.

tasks.title: Replace a floating condition with an integer predicate
requirements: Keep input f32 probability=0.5. Draw opaque background #101820 and green rect(8,8,16,16,#44ff44) when probability>0.0; do not change the input type or drop the conditional.
Repair the unsupported floating condition in the supplied source. Write point center={16,16}.

tasks.title: Repair a named builtin argument typo
requirements: Keep a named rect call drawing (8,8,16,16,#55bbff) over opaque #101820. Correct the misspelled parameter name; do not switch to an unrelated builtin.
Write point center={16,16} and preserve the five rect argument values.

tasks.title: Pass a draw uniform into a helper explicitly
requirements: Keep input color tint=#55bbff and helper paint. Repair uniform visibility by adding a typed color parameter and passing tint from draw using a positional helper call.
Paint rect(8,8,16,16,tint) over opaque #101820; write point center={16,16}; do not hard-code tint inside the helper.

tasks.title: Replace recursion with a bounded iterative helper
requirements: Keep helper height(n:i32)->i32 callable positionally. Replace recursive implementation with a terminating integer loop producing n for n in [0,8].
Root draws opaque #101820 then rect(2,2,height(4),4,#ff4444), and writes point measured={height(4),4}. Do not replace helper calls with literals.

tasks.title: Give a numeric ramp a floating palette
requirements: Keep the numeric palette levels with stops 0 and 1, and sample ramp(levels,0.5). Change literals so the palette is floating; do not remove ramp.
Write point midpoint={t,t}, where t is the sampled value. Draw background #101820 and pixel(8,8,rgb(int(t*255.0),int(t*255.0),int(t*255.0))).
tasks.initial_diagnostic_hint: ramp requires a color or f32 palette

tasks.title: Preserve a list and add a scalar attachment for part reads
requirements: Keep part-owned list point marks with its one appended {1,2}; retain the part pixel(1,2,#55bbff). Add a scalar point tip with the same position and read that scalar from root.

Root fills #101820 and calls tile.draw(7,0,0,at={8,8}). Write root point anchor=tile.outputs.tip+{8,8}; it must be {9,10}. Part-owned marks and tip remain local {1,2}. Do not read a list as an expression or delete the list.

tasks.title: Use a valid discrete part rotation
requirements: Correct rot=45 to rot=90 while preserving part geometry, origin, placement {16,16}, and three positional part arguments.

Root fills #101820 and writes anchor=tile.outputs.anchor+{16,16}. Root anchor becomes {19,22}; part-owned anchor stays local {3,6}. Do not approximate rotation with trigonometry or change geometry to mask the invalid transform.

tasks.title: Initialize a reassigned local with the right type
requirements: Keep local x starting numerically at 1, then reassign x=0.5; make x floating from its first assignment. Do not delete either assignment or alter their order.
Fill #101820, paint pixel(int(x*16.0),8,#55bbff), and write point position={x,8}. The pixel is (8,8) and position is {0.5,8}.
